name: trigger-compact
summary: Compacts context when token usage crosses a fixed threshold (default 100k, configurable) - only while pi auto-compaction (compaction.enabled) is on, only when it is below pi's own window-minus-reserve trigger, and never in a one-shot child session. A compaction that interrupts a live run is resumed once. Registers /trigger-compact and /compact-threshold [amount|off|on|reset|status].
